summary: A universal mixed L1_W(L2_v) slice norm does not follow even when (v,W) is an orthogonal transform of three independent cap-one original coordinates. Explicit fragmented Sidon supports give norm (4/3)2^(-3/4)sqrt(N)+O(N^(-1/2)). This refutes the naive same-bank conditioning bridge, not QFORM itself.
scope: Do not average r39 same-bank W-slices using only a purported universal integral ||p(v,W)(.,w)||_2 dw bound. Preserve product structure through W integration or recut original coordinates.
